Familiarity with digital thread concepts linking requirements, design, test, and operational data across the engineering lifecycle. Desired Qualifications Experience supporting DoD, or Intelligence Community digital engineering or modeling & simulation programs. Working knowledge of SysMLv2 and textual modeling tools such as SysIDE. We'd love to hear from you! If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview. Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research. Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus. Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs. A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions. Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare. You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done. We look forward to receiving your application! We believe in a transparent and engaging recruitment process that gives both sides the opportunity to get to know each other.
